```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())
```


```{r load data, warning=F, message=F}

refit_models_flag <- FALSE # Set to TRUE to refit models, which can take a long time. Set to FALSE to load previously fitted models.

source(here::here("0-config.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "0-functions.R"))

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data.rds"))

# Project coordinates to UTM so distances are in meters, not degrees

df_proj <- df_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = global_crs) %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_crs) %>% # UTM zone 31N, for Niger
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2])

# Load Niger boundaries map from Humanitarian Data Exchange
# Map downloaded from https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner on 10 March 2026

niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin1.shp"))

boxgrid <- readRDS(here("data", "niger_grid.rds"))
niger_adm2_sub <- readRDS(here("data", "niger_adm2_sub.rds"))

```

## Simple Kriging model

### Fit model
```{r fit simple kriging model}
# fit spatial models for mortality rate with binary tx vars,
# isTreated_child: 0=placebo+infant, 1=child

if(refit_models_flag) {

  tic("Simple Krig: fit spaMM model for child mortality")
  fitmort_child_simp_krig <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 +
      Matern(1 | lon + lat) +
      isTreated_child +
      # (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_simp_krig,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_simp_krig.rds"))
} else {
  fitmort_child_simp_krig <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_simp_krig.rds"))
}

```

### Summary
```{r simple krig summary}

summary(fitmort_child_simp_krig)

print(AIC(fitmort_child_simp_krig))

materncorr_simp_krig <- plot_matern_corr_proj(fitmort_child_simp_krig,
                                             "avenir-materncorr-fitmort_child_simp_krig",
                                             modelname = "Simple Kriging")

```

## Generalized kriging model

### Fit model
```{r fit gen kriging model}

if(refit_models_flag) {
  tic("Generalized Krig: fit spaMM model for child mortality with linear lat/lon terms")
  fitmort_child_gen_krig <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 +
      lat + lon +
      Matern(1 | lon + lat) +
      isTreated_child +
      # (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_gen_krig,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig.rds"))
} else{
  fitmort_child_gen_krig <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig.rds"))
}

```

### Compare to simple model

```{r compare simple and general kriging models}

print(AIC(fitmort_child_simp_krig))
print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig))

LRT(fitmort_child_gen_krig, fitmort_child_simp_krig)

```

LRT and AIC indicate that adding linear terms for latitude and longitude significantly improves model fit, i.e., the generalized krige model is preferred over the simple krige. 

### Model results

```{r model results for general kriging}

summary(fitmort_child_gen_krig)

materncorr_gen_krig <- plot_matern_corr_proj(fitmort_child_gen_krig,
                                             "avenir-materncorr-fitmort_child_gen_krig",
                                             modelname = "Generalized Kriging")

materncorr_gen_krig

```

### Fit model with random effect for site code
```{r fit gen kriging model w RE for site code}

if(refit_models_flag) {
  tic("Generalized Krig: fit spaMM model for child mortality with linear lat/lon terms and RE for site code")
  fitmort_child_gen_krig_re <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 +
      lat + lon +
      Matern(1 | lon + lat) +
      isTreated_child +
      (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"), 
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_gen_krig_re,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_re.rds"))
} else{
  fitmort_child_gen_krig_re <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_re.rds"))
}

print(AIC(fitmort_child_simp_krig))
print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig))
print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig_re))

LRT(fitmort_child_gen_krig, fitmort_child_simp_krig)
LRT(fitmort_child_gen_krig_re, fitmort_child_gen_krig)

summary(fitmort_child_gen_krig_re)

materncorr_gen_krig_re <- plot_matern_corr_proj(fitmort_child_gen_krig_re,
                                             "avenir-materncorr-fitmort_child_gen_krig_re",
                                             modelname = "Generalized Kriging with cluster RE")

materncorr_gen_krig

```


## Generalized krig with interaction

### Fit model
```{r fit interaction model}

if(refit_models_flag) {
  tic("fit spaMM model for child mortality with interaction")
  fitmort_child_gen_krig_int <- spaMM::fitme(
    n_deaths_1to59 ~
      1 + lat + lon +
      Matern(1 | lon + lat) +
      isTreated_child +
      isTreated_child * lat + isTreated_child *
      lon +
      # (1|site_code) +
      offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
    data = df_proj,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    control.HLfit = list(NbThreads = avail_thr)
  )
  toc()
  
  saveRDS(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
          here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_int.rds"))
} else {
  fitmort_child_gen_krig_int <- readRDS(here("data", "fitmort_child_gen_krig_int.rds"))
}

```

### Compare to generalized krig model

```{r compare interaction model}

print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig))
print(AIC(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int))

LRT(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int, fitmort_child_gen_krig)

```

LRT and AIC indicate that the model with the interaction between treatment label and latitude and longitude fits better than the one without interaction. 

### Model results

```{r results of the interaction model}

summary(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int)

materncorr_gen_krig_int <- plot_matern_corr_proj(fitmort_child_gen_krig_int,
                                                 "avenir-materncorr-fitmort_child_gen_krig_int",
                                                 modelname = "Generalized Kriging with Interaction")

materncorr_gen_krig_int

```

### Model predictions

```{r predictions from all models}

models_list <- list(
  simp_krig = fitmort_child_simp_krig,
  gen_krig = fitmort_child_gen_krig,
  gen_krig_re = fitmort_child_gen_krig_re,
  gen_krig_int = fitmort_child_gen_krig_int
)

tic("Get predictions from all models for both treatment groups")
preds_mort <- lapply(models_list, function(model) {
  get_grid_preds_both_tx(input_grid = boxgrid, spamm_model_fit = model)
})
toc()

preds_long <- bind_rows(preds_mort, .id = "model")

```

### ATE estimation

```{r ate estimate}

preds_wide <- preds_long %>%
  # dplyr::select(-pred_var) %>%
  rename(geometry = x) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(model, geometry), names_from = isTreated_child, values_from = pred, names_prefix = "pred") %>%
  mutate(ATE = predTreatment - predControl)

saveRDS(preds_wide, here("data", "preds_ATE.rds"))

```
